title: Color Names
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Color
learningObjectives: Identify common CSS/HTML color names and match each to the swatch it produces
Explain how a named color maps to a triple of red, green, and blue channel values from 0 to 255
Predict the RGB values of a named color from its appearance, then check the prediction against the displayed values
Distinguish colors with similar names but different RGB values, such as gray versus darkgray or blue versus navy
Explain why p5.js accepts both a color name string and an rgb() triple as arguments to fill()
